title: The Linear Programming Approach to Partially Identified Models
abstract: arXiv:2503.14940v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In many partially identified models, sharp bounds on structural or causal parameters are values of linear programs (LPs) with estimated coefficients. We introduce a debiased penalty estimator of the LP value. It is pointwise root-n-consistent whenever the population feasible set is nonempty and bounded. Although no estimator is uniformly consistent over the unrestricted collection of distributions, ours retains a one-sided guarantee: the extent to which it can overestimate a sharp lower bound vanishes uniformly. Under a condition ruling out weak identification of the bound, it is also uniformly consistent. We develop two inference procedures exploiting LP structure: a simple pointwise procedure with exact asymptotic coverage, and a uniformly valid procedure. In simulations calibrated to Holmes (2011), our estimator avoids the anticonservative bias of unregularized benchmark estimators and the conservativeness of the set expansion est

translated_title: 部分识别模型的线性规划方法
translated_abstract: 在许多部分识别模型中，结构参数或因果参数的尖锐界是带有估计系数的线性规划（LP）问题的最优值。我们提出了一种针对LP值的去偏惩罚估计量。只要总体可行集非空且有界，该估计量在逐点意义上具有根号n一致性。尽管在无限制的分布集合上任何估计量都无法做到一致一致，但我们的估计量保留了一个单侧保证：它高估尖锐下界的程度会一致地趋于消失。在排除界的弱识别问题的条件下，该估计量也是一致一致的。我们利用LP结构开发了两种推断程序：一种是具有精确渐近覆盖率的简单逐点程序，另一种是一致有效的程序。在与Holmes (2011)校准的模拟中，我们的估计量避免了未正则化基准估计量的反保守偏差，以及集合扩张估计量的保守性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种部分识别模型中线性规划值的去偏惩罚估计量，它在可行集非空有界时具有逐点根号n一致性和单侧一致保证，在排除弱识别条件下具有一致一致性，并据此开发了两种利用LP结构的推断方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a debiased penalty estimator for linear program values in partially identified models, which is pointwise root-n-consistent, retains a one-sided uniform guarantee, and becomes uniformly consistent when weak identification is ruled out, together with two LP-structure-based inference procedures.
